name: Telegram
summary: Deliver an approved recipe result to the Telegram chat you choose.

setup.credential_label: Telegram delivery approved in your own Hermes setup
setup.recommended_scope: Deliver only to the Telegram chat you select, after your approval.
setup.customer_action: In your own setup, connect Telegram, choose the destination chat, and approve the first test delivery.

customer_setup.summary: Choose one Telegram chat where you want to receive this recipe's result.
steps: Pick the Telegram chat that should receive the result.
Connect Telegram inside your own Hermes setup and review the destination.
Approve one test delivery before enabling a schedule.
customer_setup.secret_handling: Agent Recipes never asks for, displays, stores, or logs connection secrets. Complete authorization only in your customer-owned runtime.

verification.success_looks_like: One approved test result reaches only the Telegram chat you selected.
steps: Confirm the selected Telegram chat appears in the plan.
Approve and send one test result.
Confirm it did not reach any other chat.

rollback.scope: Only Telegram delivery for this selected recipe.
steps: Remove only this recipe's Telegram destination in your own runtime.
Leave unrelated recipes and Telegram destinations unchanged.
